review_scope: Independent review of backend, frontend integration, stale/failure behavior, packet copy/export path, scope isolation, and final missing frontend files.
accepted_findings: Backend routes are read-only thin wrappers over canonical_state.py and recovery_packet.py.
Observed runtime health remains clearly non-authoritative in the UI.
Refresh failures preserve last-good state and mark it stale.
Recovery packet copy/download uses the backend generator output, not browser-side reconstruction.
System Context is integrated into the existing Workbench shell without registering the dormant workbench_bp.
No Braingate/Card Factory/Card Runner feature work was activated by Card 03.
Process/container identity confusion is not a Card 03 blocker; record it as a discovery for Card 04/closeout.
